cache_identity_check.name: cache_identity_check
cache_identity_check.value: ("cache_identity"."kind" = 'default' AND "cache_identity"."name" IS NULL) OR ("cache_identity"."kind" = 'named' AND "cache_identity"."name" IS NOT NULL AND length("cache_identity"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND substr("cache_identity"."name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "cache_identity"."name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*')

cache_identity_creation_shape_check.name: cache_identity_creation_shape_check
cache_identity_creation_shape_check.value: ("cache_identity"."lifecycle_state" = 'creating' AND "cache_identity"."creation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("cache_identity"."lifecycle_state" <> 'creating' AND "cache_identity"."creation_expires_at" IS NULL)

cache_identity_management_shape_check.name: cache_identity_management_shape_check
cache_identity_management_shape_check.value: ("cache_identity"."management_kind" = 'durable' AND "cache_identity"."managed_policy_id" IS NULL AND "cache_identity"."managed_policy_revision" IS NULL AND "cache_identity"."managed_group_id" IS NULL AND "cache_identity"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "cache_identity"."selection_state" IS NULL) OR ("cache_identity"."management_kind" = 'managed' AND "cache_identity"."managed_policy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cache_identity"."managed_policy_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "cache_identity"."managed_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("cache_identity"."lifecycle_state" = 'creating' AND "cache_identity"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "cache_identity"."selection_state" = 'detached') OR ("cache_identity"."lifecycle_state" <> 'creating' AND "cache_identity"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cache_identity"."selection_state" IS NOT NULL)))

generation_seq_cache_identity_check.name: generation_seq_cache_identity_check
generation_seq_cache_identity_check.value: ("generation_seq"."cache_kind" = 'default' AND "generation_seq"."cache_name" IS NULL) OR ("generation_seq"."cache_kind" = 'named' AND "generation_seq"."cache_name" IS NOT NULL AND length("generation_seq"."cache_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND substr("generation_seq"."cache_name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "generation_seq"."cache_name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*')

retention_policy_identity_check.name: retention_policy_identity_check
retention_policy_identity_check.value: ("retention_policy"."kind" = 'cache' AND "retention_policy"."cache_id" IS NOT NULL AND "retention_policy"."root_name_prefix" IS NULL) OR ("retention_policy"."kind" = 'root-name-prefix' AND "retention_policy"."cache_id" IS NULL AND "retention_policy"."root_name_prefix" IS NOT NULL)

retention_migration_rule_prefix_check.name: retention_migration_rule_prefix_check
retention_migration_rule_prefix_check.value: length("retention_migration_rule"."root_prefix") BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND instr("retention_migration_rule"."root_prefix", char(0)) = 0 AND "retention_migration_rule"."root_prefix" NOT GLOB ('*[' || char(1) || '-' || char(31) || char(127) || ']*')

reuse_view_selector_view_check.name: reuse_view_selector_view_check
reuse_view_selector_view_check.value: length("reuse_view_selector_native"."view") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND substr("reuse_view_selector_native"."view", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."view" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*'

reuse_view_selector_identity_check.name: reuse_view_selector_identity_check
reuse_view_selector_identity_check.value: ("reuse_view_selector_native"."kind" IN ('default', 'all-named', 'all') AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name" IS NULL AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix" IS NULL AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."managed_group_id" IS NULL) OR ("reuse_view_selector_native"."kind" = 'named' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name" IS NOT NULL AND length("reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND substr("reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix" IS NULL AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."managed_group_id" IS NULL) OR ("reuse_view_selector_native"."kind" = 'prefix' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name" IS NULL AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix" IS NOT NULL AND length("reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND substr("reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."managed_group_id" IS NULL) OR ("reuse_view_selector_native"."kind" = 'managed-group' AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."cache_name" IS NULL AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."prefix" IS NULL AND "reuse_view_selector_native"."managed_group_id" IS NOT NULL)

reuse_view_name_check.name: reuse_view_name_check
reuse_view_name_check.value: length("reuse_view"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND substr("reuse_view"."name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "reuse_view"."name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*'

root_retention_rule_prefix_check.name: root_retention_rule_prefix_check
root_retention_rule_prefix_check.value: length("root_retention_rule"."root_prefix") BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND instr("root_retention_rule"."root_prefix", char(0)) = 0 AND "root_retention_rule"."root_prefix" NOT GLOB ('*[' || char(1) || '-' || char(31) || char(127) || ']*')

root_retention_rule_value_check.name: root_retention_rule_value_check
root_retention_rule_value_check.value: ("root_retention_rule"."kind" = 'permanent' AND "root_retention_rule"."ttl_seconds" IS NULL) OR ("root_retention_rule"."kind" = 'duration' AND "root_retention_rule"."ttl_seconds" BETWEEN 1 AND 315360000)
